desc:
Welcome to Grow Crystals! 💎 
Added new crystals and miners!

Are you ready to grow the biggest the biggest crystals? Buy crystals from the shop, plant them, wait for them to grow, and collect!

How to Play:
• Equip your crystal you want to plant!
• Click in your mine on the brown plots to plant!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, it is time to mine it!

⭐ Your mine grows even when you are offline!
